purpose: Retain last-resort computer-use capability while pausing effects during user activity, proving passive listener observations cannot impersonate gameplay results, and turning semantic discoveries into bounded source-test obligations.

files.reason: Annotates passive observation results from existing opt-in read-only listener; no new input executor or desktop control grant.
Keeps active session alive while paused, collects tokenized semantic observations and distinguishes observations from game effect completions.
Bounded semantic journal, paged codification tasks and provider verification ceiling; never performs game effects.
